allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "--- node ---"; try { node --version } catch { Write-Output "node NOT found" }; Write-Output "--- npm ---"; try { npm --version } catch { Write-Output "npm NOT found" }; Write-Output "--- claude ---"; try { \(Get-Command claude -ErrorAction Stop\).Source } catch { Write-Output "claude CLI NOT found on PATH" })

PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:USERPROFILE\\.local\\bin\\claude.exe","$env:USERPROFILE\\.local\\bin\\claude","$env:APPDATA\\npm\\claude.cmd","$env:USERPROFILE\\.npm-global\\bin\\claude.cmd"\); foreach\($p in $paths\){ if\(Test-Path $p\){ Write-Output "FOUND: $p" } }; Write-Output "--- npm global bin ---"; npm bin -g 2>$null; Write-Output "--- npm root -g ---"; npm root -g)

PowerShell($gh = Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($gh\) { "gh FOUND: $\($gh.Source\)"; gh --version | Select-Object -First 1 } else { "gh NOT FOUND on PATH" }; "--- docs/agents ---"; if \(Test-Path "docs/agents"\) { Get-ChildItem docs/agents -Name } else { "no docs/agents dir" }; "--- root agent files ---"; Get-ChildItem -Name CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .scratch -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)

PowerShell($j = Start-Job { docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}' 2>&1 }; if\(Wait-Job $j -Timeout 12\){ "DOCKER DAEMON: " + \(Receive-Job $j\) } else { Stop-Job $j; "DOCKER DAEMON: not responding within 12s \(Desktop likely stopped\)" }; Remove-Job $j -Force)

PowerShell($env:npm_config_yes='true'; npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20; "--- result ---"; if \(Test-Path frontend/package.json\) { "frontend/package.json created" } else { "FRONTEND NOT CREATED" })
PowerShell(npm --prefix frontend install -D eslint @eslint/js typescript-eslint eslint-plugin-boundaries eslint-plugin-react-hooks prettier eslint-config-prettier)

PowerShell("=== ESLINT ==="; npm --prefix frontend run lint 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20; "=== EXIT $LASTEXITCODE ==="; "=== PRETTIER CHECK ==="; npm --prefix frontend run format 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 6; "=== EXIT $LASTEXITCODE ===")

PowerShell(Push-Location backend; php artisan scribe:generate 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20; Pop-Location; "--- openapi files ---"; Get-ChildItem -Recurse backend/storage/app, backend/public -Include openapi.yaml,openapi.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName })

PowerShell(Push-Location frontend; npx orval --config orval.config.ts 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20; Pop-Location; "--- generated files ---"; Get-ChildItem frontend/src/shared/api/generated -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
PowerShell("=== TYPECHECK ==="; npm --prefix frontend run typecheck 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20; "=== EXIT $LASTEXITCODE ===")
PowerShell(Push-Location frontend; "=== npm run api:check ==="; npm run api:check 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 12; "=== EXIT $LASTEXITCODE ==="; Pop-Location)
